# ATAS.TECH — Boutique AI Research Lab (Singapore, est. 2018)

atas.tech is the hub for Atas Tech's projects: zero-knowledge secret infrastructure for
AI agents, supply-chain guardrails for agentic coding, and trust tooling plus Quickshell
bar plugins for Omarchy Linux. Operator: Hung Vo (DevSecOps & AI Engineer).

- Site: https://atas.tech
- GitHub (lab): https://github.com/atas-tech
- GitHub (OmaSafe & Omarchy plugins): https://github.com/tuthan
- Portfolio: https://portfolio.atas.tech/

## Latest: OmaSafe (trust & security for Omarchy)

- OmaSafe CLI (`omasafe-cli`, Rust, v0.3.1, signed release 2026-09-09, MIT):
  bounded, evidence-first review of Omarchy plugins (exact revisions, shipped payloads,
  capabilities, drift from a pinned trust baseline), host posture (encryption, firewall,
  updates, listeners, kernel/package state, persistence), and pre-install candidates
  (GitHub URLs, Git revisions, pasted install commands). Never labels a plugin safe or
  malicious, never executes plugin code, runs unprivileged.
  https://github.com/tuthan/omasafe · docs: https://tuthan.github.io/omasafe/
- OmaSafe Omarchy plugin (`io.github.tuthan.omasafe`, v0.5.0): bar widget and review panel
  over installed plugins and the host; thin QML client over omasafe-cli.
  https://github.com/tuthan/omasafe-plugin ·
  https://plugins.omarchy.org/plugin.html?id=io.github.tuthan.omasafe
- OmaSafe Agent Skill (`omasafe-plugin-review`, v1.4.0): portable Agent Skills package for
  Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode that reviews plugins through the local CLI.
  https://github.com/tuthan/omasafe-agent-skill

## Omarchy plugins (Quickshell bar widgets, MIT, listed on plugins.omarchy.org)

- Dropdown Terminal (`io.github.tuthan.dropdown-terminal`, v2.3.0): focused floating
  terminal overlay for Hyprland with bounded entrance effects, interactive pets, and
  privacy-preserving command-completion indicators.
  https://github.com/tuthan/omarchy-dropdown-terminal
- Unraid (`io.github.hvo.omarchy-unraid`, v1.0.1): monitor an Unraid server from the bar
  over the native GraphQL API — array, disks, parity, CPU/memory, Docker, VMs.
  https://github.com/tuthan/omarchy-unraid
- Lunar Calendar (`io.github.tuthan.omarchy-lunar-calendar`, v1.1.0): East Asian lunar
  calendar, moon phase, Can Chi, 24 solar terms, and activity manager.
  https://github.com/tuthan/omarchy-lunar-calendar

## Agent security

- BlindPass: zero-knowledge secret provisioning for AI agents (SPS coordinator, HPKE,
  in-memory-only storage, single-use out-of-band links, gateway anti-phishing).
  https://blindpass.atas.tech · https://github.com/atas-tech/blindpass
- BlindDrop: one-time, zero-knowledge secret sharing (client-side AES-256-GCM, key in URL
  fragment, optional PBKDF2 passphrase, ephemeral Redis TTL).
  https://blinddrop.atas.tech · https://github.com/atas-tech/blinddrop
- Dependency Guard: portable dependency-review guardrail for agentic coding workflows
  (Codex/OpenClaw skill, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Socket-backed checks, GitHub Actions example).
  https://clawhub.ai/tuthan/dependency-guard · https://github.com/atas-tech/dependency-guard
